verdict.rationale: Claude Design outputs are HTML/CSS/JS and can be exported to PPTX/PDF/HTML, and an Anthropic team member confirmed 'Claude's designs are HTML/CSS/JS that any editor can handle,' supporting portability outside the vendor tool. However, there is no formal documented file-format spec, some export/import friction was reported (large .fig import errors, SVG export stripping animations unless a workaround extension is used), and a subscription-lockout incident briefly limited access to designs. missing for 10: an explicit published file-format specification, confirmation that all design assets (not just code) remain fully toolable elsewhere, and resolution details on the export-after-cancellation fix.
